verses.2720: fatabbat yadākum ʾayyuhā l-ʿuṣbahu llatī tusīʾu birasmi l-badri sirri l-bariyyati
verses.2721: fashullat yadākum biʾisa mā qad ʾathartumu mina ṣ-ṣadri ʾaḍghānā ladaykum kajamrati
verses.2722: fāʾāmālukum khābat waḍāʿat juhūdukum wa ʿishtum ḥayāta l-muʿtadīna bikhasrati
verses.2723: wa ʾantum musīʾūna bihi wa bidīnihi falā niltumu fawzā ʿalā sūʾi niyyati
verses.2724: tajarraʾatumu ʾantum ʿalayhi birasmihi ʾayursamu nūru lā yuṭāqu binaẓrati
verses.2725: huwa l-jawharu l-maknūnu was-sababu lladhī falawlāhu mā kāna l-wujūdu bikhilqahi
verses.2726: wa ʾarwāḥu kulli l-muhtadīna bihi ghadat mina s-saqyī ʾanwārā likashfi d-dujunnati
verses.2727: mina l-ʾanbiyā wa l-mursalīna wa ghayrihim mina l-mursalīna rūḥuhu ʾuṣlu nashʾahi
verses.2728: wa man lam yanal min saqyihi bāta mulḥidā wa ʿāsha shaqiyyā kāfirā kulla daʿwati
verses.2729: fahadhā rasūlu llāhi wa s-sanadu lladhī shafāʿatuhu turjā ghadā yawma rahbahi
verses.2730: fahadhā rasūlu llāhi wa s-sulamu lladhī bihi yartaqī l-ʾabrāru sayrā liḥaḍrati
verses.2731: fahadhā rasūlu lil-bariyyati kullihim saʿādatuhum wa fawzuhum ʿaynu raḥmahi
verses.2732: fahadhā rasūlu llāhi wa l-ʾakmalu lladhī famā ramaqat ʿaynu shabīhā lirawʿati
verses.2733: fahadhā rasūlu llāhi wa l-manbaʿu lladhī fuyūḍātuhu tajrī ʾilā yawmi nafkhahi
verses.2734: fahadhā rasūlu lan tara l-ʿaynu mithlahu mina l-khalqi wa l-khulqi faʾakbaru ʾāyati
verses.2735: nudāfiʿu ʿanhu kullamā qāma muʿtadi faʾaḥmadu ḥaqā ʿizzunā ʾayyū ʿizzati
verses.2736: kamā ʾannanā naʾabā l-ʾisāʾata naḥwahu lanarfaḍuhā qaṭʿā tijāha l-ʾaʾimmahi
verses.2737: ruwaydakumu hadhā n-nabiyū malādhunā waqudwatunā fī dīninā khayru ʾuswati
verses.2738: ʿalā mahlikum ʾinnā ʿtaṣamnā biḥablihi bimillatihi l-ʾislāmi naḥyā kaʾummahi
verses.2739: ṭarīqatukum masdūdatu ʿindamā ʾatā ʿalā sabbih kan-nāṭiḥīna biṣakhrati
verses.2740: ḍarabtum ḥadīdā bāridā lātuʿʿadhibū biʾaydīkumu hadhā lasharru l-baliyyati
verses.2741: faʾummatuhi bis-silmi tadʿū kamā daʿat shuʿūbā fanālat sumʿaha khayra sumʿahi
verses.2742: nudīnu bihadhāʾālrrasmi fī shakhṣihi lladhī fabayna s-samā wal-ʾarḍi ʾaʿẓamu ḥurmahi
verses.2743: wa rutbatuhu l-qaʿshāʾu fātat falam yakun tashawwahu yawmā ʾaw yunālu bituhmahi
verses.2744: ʾunāshidu ʾikhwānī mina d-dīni jumlaha ʿalā fahmi waʿyī d-dīni fiqhā kasīrati
verses.2745: waʾan yamnaʿū nayla r-rusūmi faman saʿā ʾilā nashrihā yaʿdū kafāʿili sabbahi
verses.2746: ʿalā ʾusrati d-dunyā shuʿūbā wa qādata wifāqu limanʿi l-massi ḥurmaha jillahi
verses.2747: wa nahyī ntihāki lil-mashāʿiri ʾinna dhā layaḍmanu ʿayshā hayyinā lil-khalīfati
verses.2748: fayaḥyā l-warā jawwa t-tafāhumi hakadhā daʿā dīnunā l-ʾislāmu ʾamthalu millahi
verses.2749: wa rājiʿ jaʿalnākum shuʿūbā faʾinnahā bayānu mina l-mawlā liʾaʿẓami ʾusrati
verses.2750: ṣalātu wa taslīmu ʿalā khayri man daʿā jamīʿa l-warā lid-dīni jabrā likasrati
verses.2751: maʿa l-ʾāli wal-ʾaṣḥābi māqultu munshidā tusīʾu birasmi l-badri sirri l-bariyyati
